sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《PanCancer insights from The Cancer Genome Atlas: the pathologist's perspective》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) represents one of several international consortia dedicated to performing comprehensive genomic and epigenomic analyses of selected tumour types to advance our understanding of disease and provide an open-access resource for worldwide cancer research.
